aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a demolition supervisor prepares to tear down New Orleans' Historic Palace Theatre, he confronts the tragic, spectral souls trapped inside who reveal the horrifying truth behind its closure.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: The historic Palace Theatre was once a cherished crown jewel of New Orleans, but its sudden, mysterious closure left it abandoned to time. Years later, a practical demolition supervisor arrives on-site to oversee the building's final destruction. As he walks the vacant halls, he makes contact with the restless spirits of those who perished within its walls. Forced to listen to their haunting testimonies, he realizes the theatre hides a dark past that refuses to be buried under rubble.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the heart of New Orleans, the Historic Palace Theatre stands as a crumbling monument to a forgotten era. Appointed to oversee its immediate demolition, a pragmatic project supervisor arrives expecting a routine tear-down job. However, as heavy machinery prepares to breach the structure, strange paranormal phenomena begin to manifest throughout the auditorium. Disturbed by eerie occurrences, the supervisor investigates the shadows and discovers that he is not alone inside the locked building. The souls of those lost during the theatre's final night are trapped within its walls, desperate to share their stories. Through chilling encounters and spectral visions, the spirits piece together the tragic night that led to the venue's abrupt shutdown. Each apparition reveals a fragment of a dark thriller that unfolds into a nightmare of betrayal, terror, and loss. As the clock ticks down toward the planned demolition, the supervisor finds himself caught between his corporate duty and the ghosts demanding justice. He must navigate the haunting psychological toll of their secrets before the wrecking ball swings and erases their tragic truth forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the atmospheric backdrop of New Orleans, 'P A L A C E' blends horror, thriller, and drama into a haunting story of memory and loss. The narrative follows a demolition supervisor assigned to clear out the city's beloved Historic Palace Theatre. What begins as an ordinary site inspection quickly turns into a terrifying confrontation with the supernatural when the lingering spirits of the deceased reveal why the landmark was abruptly shuttered. To survive the night and understand the tragic history embedded in the architecture, the supervisor must bear witness to the harrowing stories of the lost souls trapped inside.
